tests.name: Test AVL Tree Insertion and Balancing
tests.run: python3 -c "from avl_tree import AVLTree; tree = AVLTree(); values = [10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 25]; [tree.insert(v) for v in values]; assert tree.inorder() == [10, 20, 25, 30, 40, 50]; print('PASS')"

tests.name: Test AVL Tree Left Rotation
tests.run: python3 -c "from avl_tree import AVLTree; tree = AVLTree(); values = [10, 20, 30]; [tree.insert(v) for v in values]; assert tree.root.value == 20; print('PASS')"
